facts.fact: Meera re-stitched the count's spine after every drop for ten winters, and sewed the brass button token into it the night after the last drop (the ch 1 drop). Corrects the earlier 'ten winters back' stitching; consistent with F052. Her match to Varun's coat button rests on it being new, brass, domed and plain, of the same pattern, with a shank never sewn to anything.
Nimmi says Meera's ring and little fingers must come off two days after the Fair, matching F260. Supersedes F245's 'a day after'.
Meera has seen the new brass button on Varun's coat in the Kothi yard (F060/F385) and tells Asha so; Asha independently saw one on the day Varun hired her.
